- The **sugar box is still on the table**, lying flat near the front left. Estimated top-plane center: **x≈0.643, y≈−0.406, z≈0.045 m**. Its long footprint axis is nearly world x; short axis nearly world y. Top-plane spans about 0.174 × 0.092 m.

- Cans remain on the table. Mustard is lying inside the bin.
